cards.text: Jesus and His disciples arrive at Bethsaida, and some people bring Him a man who is blind. They don't just ask Jesus for help, friend. They BEG Him, the way I beg my oven timer to hurry up, except this actually matters.

cards.question: Some people in Bethsaida bring a blind man to Jesus. They beg Jesus to ___ him.

cards.text: Jesus takes the blind man by the hand and starts leading him somewhere. I bet every step feels like a mystery to that man.

cards.question: Jesus takes the blind man by the hand. Where does Jesus lead him?

cards.text: Out past the village, Jesus spits on the man's eyes and places His hands on him. Then He asks, “Can you see anything?”
The man looks up and says, “I can see the people, but they look like trees walking around.”

cards.question: The man says people look like trees walking around. Right now, he can see everything clearly.
The man can see people, but they look like trees walking around. What does Jesus do next?

answers.text: Places His hands on his eyes again
Sends him to wash in a pool
Tells him to come back later

cards.text: Once again, Jesus places His hands on the man's eyes, and the man opens them. Friend, I'm on the edge of my gold base right now.

cards.question: When the man opens his eyes this time, he can see everything clearly.

cards.text: Now he can see everything clearly, sharp as a fresh stamp on cookie dough. Then Jesus sends him home.

cards.question: Jesus sends the healed man home. What does Jesus tell him as he goes?

answers.text: Do not go back into the village
Go tell everyone in the village
Go show yourself to the priests
